sources.stock_dump: m5stack-tab5-linux-images/stock-2026-11-10 (SHA256SUMS.txt, boot-log.txt, live-log.txt, tab5-stock.bin; no extracted sdkconfig or usb-devices capture exists in this dump)

observed.usb_device: USB Serial/JTAG, VID 303A PID 1001 (inferred: standard P4 USJ VID/PID seen at COM13 during earlier probing; the stock dump folder contains no usb-devices capture)

stock_readback.notes: stock app brownouts on plain USB power once speaker amp + 100% backlight + C6 AP are up (BOD in live-log.txt); Linux boot keeps the amp off and backlight low

internal_i2c.scan_evidence: boot-log.txt i2c probe lists 0x10 0x28 0x32 0x36 0x40 0x41 0x43 0x44 0x55 0x68 on the measured unit; 0x51 (RX8130 RTC) and 0x34 (TCA8418 keypad) were NOT present in that scan - the addresses below split observed vs inferred accordingly

devices.0x32: unidentified (seen in stock scan; possibly PMIC/charger, inferred)
devices.0x55: ST712x touch (reg 0x0000 first byte: 1 = ST7121, 3 = ST7123; this unit reads 1)
devices.0x51: RX8130 RTC (M5 docs; NOT in this unit's scan - inferred)
devices.0x34: TCA8418 keypad (keyboard units; NOT in this unit's scan - inferred)

P2.boot_state: out 0 (off to save power; stock drives 1)

P4.boot_state: latch 0, drive low ~10ms, release as input+pull-up; pulsed again for 100 ms together with P5 right before the display init (stock bsp_reset_tp)

P5.boot_state: out 1 (released); the ST712x chips are combined display+touch chips and the stock BSP pulses TP_RST low for 100 ms together with LCD_RST right before the display init (bsp_reset_tp), as the shim does

c6_sdio.routing: GPIO matrix (slot 0 has fixed GPIO39-44 pads and cannot route these pins)
c6_sdio.reset_polarity: active-low pulse (C6 EN); released high, 1.5 s readiness wait
c6_sdio.transport: SDIO 4-bit 40 MHz max (5 MHz Linux default as on Stamp)
c6_sdio.firmware: stock ships ESP-Hosted-MCU flavour; ESP-Hosted-NG network_adapter required and flashed via SDIO host_performs_slave_ota (linux/m2/ota-host, Tab5 sdkconfig variant)

display.panel: ST7121 on the measured unit (stock log: "Detected ST7121 touch controller (FW version: 1), using ST7121 display"); the BSP also handles ST7123 and ILI9881C/GT911 units, the shim picks ST7121 or ST7123 from the touch firmware byte and skips the display on anything else
display.dsi: 2 data lanes, 965 Mbps per lane for both ST7121 and ST7123 (M5Tab5-UserDemo bsp_display_new_with_handles_to_st7123), LDO_VO3 2500 mV for PHY
display.dpi: RGB565, 70 MHz, hsync 2/40/40, vsync pulse/back/front 20/24/200 (ST7121) or 2/8/220 (ST7123)
display.backlight: GPIO22, LEDC 5 kHz; stock runs 100% (12-bit, timer 0, ch1), the shim boots at ~30% (10-bit, XTAL)
display.touch: ST712x I2C 0x55 (stock driver prints it as ST7123, firmware 1.80.1.16 on this unit), INT GPIO23, TP_RST expander 0x43 P5

usb.usb_c: USB Serial/JTAG console (CDC-ACM + JTAG), VID 303A PID 1001
usb.otg11_fs: DWC @0x50040000 on internal FSLS PHY GPIO26/27 -- NOT wired to a connector on Tab5 (pins are I2S audio)
usb.otg20_hs: DWC2 @0x50000000, dedicated USB2.0 HS pads -> USB-A host port; 5V switch expander 0x44 P3

storage.microsd: SDMMC slot 0 dedicated pads CLK43 CMD44 D0-3=39-42, LDO_VO4 3.3V

audio.pa: NS4150B via expander 0x43 P1 (kept off at boot)
audio.note: GPIO26/27 are I2S pins; they conflict with the OTG11 FS PHY, which is unused on Tab5

linux.smp: C68 dual-core path inherited from Stamp port
